episode.title: Hot Cocoa Song Preschool | Frozen Cocoa Surprise! | Thumpy Meadow
episode.description_intro: Join Cow, Lamb, Piglet, and Puppy for four silly Christmas surprises full of giggles and friendship! Sing along to festive tunes as our cozy animal friends solve their funny holiday problems together.
learning_points: Sharing and helping friends feels wonderful
It is okay when things do not go as planned
Celebrating small moments makes everyone happy
Kindness and patience are always a good idea

es.title: ¡Sorpresa de Cacao Helado! Canción de Amigos Navideños | Thumpy Meadow
es.description: ¡Únete a Vaca, Cordero, Cerdito y Cachorro en cuatro divertidas sorpresas navideñas! Canta con sus simpáticos amigos animales mientras resuelven sus graciosos problemas juntos.

pt.title: Surpresa de Cacau Gelado! Canção dos Amigos de Natal | Thumpy Meadow
pt.description: Junte-se à Vaca, ao Cordeiro, ao Porquinho e ao Filhote em quatro surpresas natalinas cheias de risadas! Cante junto com esses amigos animais enquanto resolvem juntos seus problemas engraçados.

tr.title: Dondurulmuş Kakao Sürprizi! Noel Arkadaşları Şarkısı | Thumpy Meadow
tr.description: İnek, Kuzu, Domuz Yavrusu ve Köpek Yavrusu ile dört komik Noel sürprizine katılın! Sevimli hayvan arkadaşlar komik sorunlarını birlikte çözerken onlarla birlikte şarkı söyleyin.

id.title: Kejutan Coklat Beku! Lagu Teman Natal | Thumpy Meadow
id.description: Ikuti Sapi, Domba, Babi Kecil, dan Anjing Kecil dalam empat kejutan Natal yang lucu penuh tawa! Nyanyikan bersama teman-teman hewan yang menggemaskan saat mereka menyelesaikan masalah lucu mereka bersama.

stories.name: Cow's Cocoa Gets Cold!

hook.say: Oh! My cocoa is getting cold!

lines: Cow made cocoa warm and sweet
E I E I O
By the tree smelled so good to eat
E I E I O
With a wait wait here and a wait wait there
Here a wait there a wait everywhere a wait wait
No one came to have a treat
E I E I O
Lamb came walking through the door
E I E I O
Saw the cocoa on the cold floor
E I E I O
With a moo moo here and a moo moo there
Here a moo there a moo everywhere a moo moo
Lamb sat down to have some more
E I E I O
Piglet hopped and skipped right in
E I E I O
Took a great big warm cocoa sip
E I E I O
With a yum yum here and a yum yum there
Here a yum there a yum everywhere a yum yum
Warm and cozy sip by sip
E I E I O

talk.say: Me too! Me too! I am here!

lines: Now the cocoa warmed them all
E I E I O
By the tree beside the old wall
E I E I O
With a moo moo here and a moo moo there
Here a moo there a moo everywhere a moo moo
Best of all with friends this fall
E I E I O

talk.say: Now it is so warm and fun!

ending.say: Warm cocoa is better with friends!

stories.next: Hmm, where did that ribbon go?

stories.name: Lamb Can't Find the Ribbon!

hook.say: Oh no! Where is my ribbon?

lines: Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Lamb has lost her bow
She looked around the barn all day long
Up and down the row now
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Where did that bow go
She needs it for her special big gift
In the fluffy snow
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Cow looked left and right
She searched behind the cozy soft hay
In the cold winter light
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
No bow did she see
But she kept on looking around still
Happy as can be

talk.say: I will check behind the hay!

lines: Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Puppy gave a woof
The ribbon caught upon the old fence
Blowing like a big poof
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Puppy brought it back
Now the gift is all nicely wrapped up
Red and right on track

talk.say: I found it by the fence!

lines: Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Ribbon on the bow
The gift looks so beautiful and bright
Shining bright in the snow
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
Friends helped save the day
Lamb is so very happy once again
Hip hip hip hooray

talk.say: Oh thank you so much! Baa!

stories.next: Ooh, what is Piglet nibbling on?

stories.name: Piglet Eats the Decorations!

lines: Piglet saw the shiny tree
Round and bright for all to see
Each ball looked just like a sweet
Could they be a yummy treat
Piglet reached and took a bite
Oh that did not feel quite right
Not a candy not a sweet
Not a cookie not a treat
Piglet laughed and shook his head
Funny balls are hung instead
Cow and Lamb they laughed along
Everything was not so wrong
Cow brought out a real sweet treat
Something good and nice to eat
Piglet smiled so very wide
Happy feelings all inside
Now the tree was whole and bright
Everything felt warm and right

talk.say: Here is a real candy for you!

lines: Lamb put back each shiny ball
Hung them on the tree so tall
Piglet helped and did his best
Put each ornament to rest
Now the tree looks beautiful
Wonderful and colorful
Piglet learned a funny thing
Ornaments are not for treats
Candy is the real sweet treat
That is good and nice to eat
Everyone laughed all day long
Friendship makes the whole world strong

stories.next: Hm? I hear a big woof outside!

hook.say: Woof! I love running in snow!

lines: Puppy ran across the snow
Through the snow, through the snow
Bumped the snowman soft and so low
Down it tumbled so
Puppy sat beside the snow
Near the snow, near the snow
Looked around with both ears hung low
What a funny show

talk.say: Oh no! I am so sorry!

lines: Lamb came over through the snow
Through the snow, through the snow
Packed the snowballs up in a row
Stacking high and low

talk.say: Let us build it up again!

lines: Cow put on the cozy scarf
Warm and cozy scarf
Snowman stood up and made them laugh
Better than before

talk.say: And here is a warm scarf for him!

lines: Puppy wagged his tail with joy
With so much joy with joy
Everyone the snow all enjoyed
Hip hip hip hooray

episode.goodbye: Bye bye, friends! See you next time!
